name: Tao of the Breath of Power

effects.l1: Improvised shield: +2 to Active Defense with a harmless object (cloth, fan, cloak).
effects.l2: Hidden blade: a harmless object becomes a weapon with 2 damage.
effects.l3: Invisible armor: clothing worn next to the skin gives protection 3.
effects.l4: Martial skill of the improvised weapon: use Combat Techniques and other Taos with improvised weapons.

system.description: Breathe Chi into everyday objects (used with Improvisation). Lasts the current round unless stated.
